title: MTX_Dr_Pepper_5

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift stabs blindly!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor stabs with her dagger! The blade hits home! Taylor, roll for damage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... Here goes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's a critical hit!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Indeed it is... Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendan the Magical feels a sharp, shooting pain in his side! He collapses!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan! No! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your blindfolds are pulled off, and the audience roars with laughter as Taylor discovers the person she has slain... Is Brendan the Magical!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan! Nooooo!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Mwahahahahaha!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Happy Garh'alla, everyone!
That was a pretty bad ending! Try again to see what happens if Taylor holds back and `doesn't` accidentally wound Brendan the Magical!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was a pretty bad ending! Try again to see what happens if Taylor holds back and [b]doesn't[/b] accidentally wound Brendan the Magical!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it's too risky! I won't attack without even knowing who I'm attacking.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And why not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um, hello? We're all in the same gladiator pit in close proximity. How do I know I'm not, like, fighting Brendan or Angie without even realizing it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Andrew, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've never... Seen... Such a thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Andrew is... Speechless!
After a moment, Andrew clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Most impressive. Taylor the Swift, you saw through the most clever of my traps. Congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For that, I believe your little team has earned my forgiveness.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And a trip to the tobogganing on Mount Despair.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And a loot drop.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I guess all's well that ends well.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Precisely.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Andrew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor the Swift?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Happy Garh'alla!
That's it for this episode! Thanks for playing!
And from everyone at Surviving High School, wishing you a happy Winter Celebration of Garh'alla! See you next time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are we going to the goblin tobogganing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Somehow, I have a feeling we're going to miss the tobogganing this year, friend Erik.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The dragons lift you up and away, carrying you effortlessly, quickly, and swiftly to the gladiator holding cells of Tal-halla-shen.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There, you are each blindfolded, then led out into the ring. You hear the thunderous applause and jeers of the spectators and feel the flames of the fire pits!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't like where this is going...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You are each stripped of your weapons and handed a rusty dagger.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's a fight to the death against a barbarian horde! Your fight for survival begins now! May the worthy survive!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... What's around us?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You can't see anything!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, my character feels around blindly.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your hand hits something... Or someone! You better hurry up and get a plan together! You hear the rush of barbarian footsteps!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor, you feel something run into you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is ridiculous! I can't see anything! How do I know what to do? I run!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor runs into another gladiator! Taylor, what do you do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just stab blindly! It's your only chance!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I'm` running this game! `I` make the rules in Helzeroth! `I AM THE LAW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] running this game! [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] make the rules in Helzeroth! [color=#e23b3b][i]I AM THE LAW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But you'll see. I have some very special Garh'alla plans for all of you!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There's no such thing as this 'Christmas' of which you speak here in Helzeroth!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, after today, I'll make sure you `never` forget that Garh'alla is definitely `not` Christmas!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, after today, I'll make sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] forget that Garh'alla is definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's right! Garh'alla is all about blood wafers, tobogganing goblins, and the blindfolded gladiator pit fights!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You know, I think I know just the place to take all of you so that this `really` feels like Garh'alla.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, I think I know just the place to take all of you so that this [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] feels like Garh'alla.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: How dare you! You don't even know the `name` of the Winter Celebration!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you! You don't even know the [color=#e23b3b][i]name[/i][/color] of the Winter Celebration!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, after today, I'll make sure you `never` forget what Garh'alla is all about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, after today, I'll make sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] forget what Garh'alla is all about!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The dragons come around for a second pass... Their talons reach out to grab each of you!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Roll to see if you evade successfully.
Everyone grabs a dice and rolls...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gulp... 1.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Angie trips over her own feet, falling face-first into the mud as a dragon grabs her! Brendan runs straight into the dragon's outstretched claws!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Erik pulls out his sword and stabs himself in the foot before one of the dragons grabs him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not my foot! Eiieeee!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift! You're our only hope now!
Taylor picks up the die... And rolls!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 15! With my dexterity of 17, that should be more than enough to...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wrong! The dragon casts a Confusion Spell on you. That means you need a roll of 18 or better!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You clumsily lurch to the side, and the dragon ensnares you with his talons!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Andrew, that's...

options.label: Not in the spirit of Christmas.
Not in the spirit of Garh'alla.
Not in the spirit of Ghar'lic.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift dodges to the side.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nice dodge!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And what, exactly, are you blocking `with?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And what, exactly, are you blocking [color=#e23b3b][i]with?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You don't have a shield, and you're a ranger! You don't wear any armor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... Um... Forgot that.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: ...And a blast of flame engulfs Taylor the Swift, burning off all of her golden hair!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Not my beautiful, golden hair!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's too late for your precious hair.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift stands stupidly by, staring at her feet and muttering to herself in useless phrases!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.title: Christmas in Helzeroth
nodes.subtitle: Because every world deserves a chance to celebrate...

nodes.text: Happy Holidays! Welcome to a special premium mini-episode of Surviving High School!
For this mini-episode, we're taking you to the imaginary world of Helzeroth in the nerds' Ogres and Elves role playing game!
You'll play as Taylor to see if you can help her survive the holidays!
It's Christmas Eve and the nerds are gathered in Helzeroth for a special role-playing event...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Thank you all for joining me on this special day, December 24th.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thank you for planning this special celebration for us, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't get it... Is Christmas Eve in Helzeroth a really big deal or something?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: To be clear, there is no 'Christmas' in Helzeroth. By pure coincidence, the Winter Celebration of Garh'alla just happens to fall on December 24th.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we're actually celebrating some creepy Garh'alla thing?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wrong again. Our `characters` are celebrating their beloved ancestral festival of Garh'alla.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wrong again. Our [color=#e23b3b][i]characters[/i][/color] are celebrating their beloved ancestral festival of Garh'alla.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Isn't that right, team?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, Winter Celebration of Garh'alla, is there anything more magical than watching the goblins tobogganing down the icy Mountain of Despair?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm looking forward to the blindfolded gladiator fights tonight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I baked cookies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They're little gingerbread men shaped like our characters and I even used colored icing to...
In real life, Andrew slaps the cookies out of Erik's hands.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unless those are Groekan Blood-Wafers, `we're` not eating them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless those are Groekan Blood-Wafers, [color=#e23b3b][i]we're[/i][/color] not eating them.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I spent all morning decorating those.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Could you be any `less` in character? A one-armed giant would `never` bake cookies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Could you be any [color=#e23b3b][i]less[/i][/color] in character? A one-armed giant would [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] bake cookies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But... I...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Come on, people! I've crafted a magnificent gaming experience for you. Show some commitment!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Calm down, Andrew! It's just a game.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just... A... `GAME?`

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Er... Taylor, I think you just crossed a line...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Up in the sky, you suddenly see a shadow that blocks out the sun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! It can't be!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a dragon, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Try a `horde` of dragons! They swoop down, breathing fire at Angie Elfendale and Brendan the Magical!
nodes.text_bbcode: Try a [color=#e23b3b][i]horde[/i][/color] of dragons! They swoop down, breathing fire at Angie Elfendale and Brendan the Magical!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Angie Elfendale blocks with her shield!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Brendan the Magical rolls to the side!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A blast of flame shoots straight at the ranger, Taylor the Swift!

menu.title: Think fast!
menu.text: A blast of flame shoots straight at Taylor the Swift!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
